categories.node: expressible with OctaneNode's intentionally opaque unknown contract; object-backed renderables are accepted
categories.intrinsicAttributes: expressible with Octane.JSX.IntrinsicElements; its intentional type-only React lineage preserves equal strictness
categories.events: expressible through Octane's strict intrinsic surface and native DOM event callbacks
categories.css: expressible through the strict intrinsic style property
categories.ref: expressible through the Octane JSX ref contract
categories.dispatch: expressible as a value-or-updater function union and single-argument dispatcher
categories.jsxResult: expressible as OctaneNode, subject to the Octane package's own declaration dependencies

constraints: The binding must derive strict host types from Octane rather than hand-writing or widening them.
The binding must not require a React runtime dependency or a non-optional React/ReactDOM peer.
Type-only React lineage inherited through Octane is acceptable because Octane owns that dependency.
